dict.string: ScrollDeeds uses Family Controls to help you manage screen time through Islamic mindfulness. Lock distracting apps and unlock them by reciting dhikr.
ScrollDeeds sends notifications to remind you when your screen time expires and to help you maintain mindful phone usage.
ScrollDeeds uses speech recognition to verify your dhikr recitation. Your audio is processed on-device and sent to our secure verification service.
ScrollDeeds needs microphone access to record your dhikr recitation for verification.
